subject: Dynamic burst SLA and commit-scaling proposal for launch week
body:
From: Sam Park <sam@olive.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@olive.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:14:23 -0700
Subject: Launch week capacity - can you cover 4x burst?

Hi Jasmine,

We have a product launch scheduled for Aug 12 and we expect traffic to spike ~3.5-4x our baseline for ~72 hours. We like the Dedicated offer you shared, but want to understand if you can guarantee throughput during launch week or if there is a safe/paid way to provision additional burst above our reserved commit. Specifically:

- Can we temporarily raise the burst cap to 400% of our baseline for up to 72 hours?
- Is there a different surge rate for this kind of short-term event vs. continuous autoscale?
- Any cooldowns or hard limits we should be aware of?

Please share an estimated cost and whether Redwood can make an exception to the 30-day cooldown for this one-off launch.

Thanks,
Sam Park
Head of Infrastructure, Olive AI

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Park <sam@olive.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:02:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity - can you cover 4x burst?

Hi Sam — great to hear about the launch, congrats. Quick answers up front: yes, we can support a temporary 4x burst; cost depends on the duration and whether you want a guaranteed SLA during the spike.

I attached a short cost worksheet (2027-07-29_OliveAI_launch_estimate.xlsx) with two paths:

1) Reserve baseline commit + pay time-limited burst buffer (per-minute surge rate, no change to cooldown)
2) Reserve a temporary uplift (one-week peak commit) at a discounted uplift rate + no surge surcharge

The trade-offs: path (1) is flexible but has a higher instantaneous per-token surcharge; path (2) is cheaper for longer sustained spikes but requires a short-term increase to your reserved commit. On the cooldown waiver: we can offer a one-time launch exception (no 30-day cooldown) if Olive signs a short addendum committing to a minimum spend for the quarter.

Would you prefer the per-minute surge quote or the temporary uplift firm price?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:05:47 -0700
Subject: RE: Launch week capacity - can you cover 4x burst? (pricing guidance)

Folks,

Thoughts on pricing tiers:
- Per-minute surge: 2.5x baseline per-token rate for minutes over baseline throughput, billed in 1-minute buckets.
- Temporary uplift (1-week commit): 1.25x baseline per-token rate for all tokens during uplift week; counts toward quarterly commit.
- One-time cooldown waiver: requires a minimum $75k spend during the quarter and Finance sign-off.

If Olive is pushing to 72 hours, temporary uplift looks cheaper and simpler for them. We should give both numbers and call out the effect on their committed utilization.

Ben
Director, Revenue Operations

---

From: Sam Park <sam@olive.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@olive.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 08:23:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity - can you cover 4x burst?

Thanks Jasmine — the workbook is helpful. Olive prefers the temporary uplift model if that means predictable billing with no surge invoices. Two follow-ups:

1) Can you commit to throughput (p95 latency) during the uplift week? We need at least 150ms p95 for gen requests.
2) If we agree to the $75k quarterly minimum for the cooldown waiver, can Redwood also guarantee one dedicated region (us-west) routing for the uplift period?

If we can get the SLA and the region guarantee I'm happy to move to an addendum and quick signature.

Sam

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:17:36 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Olive AI uplift ask — SLA + region + cooldown waiver (urgent)

Team — Olive wants: temporary 1-week uplift (4x baseline), 150ms p95 guarantee during that week, us-west region routing, and a cooldown waiver tied to $75k quarterly commit. They prefer the uplift billing model. Can we green-light this and what approvals do we need?

Karthik — technical: can we guarantee 150ms p95 at 4x baseline for a 72-hour window on a Dedicated pool with a short-term uplift? Any caveats re: KV cache warm-up or cold-starts?
Ben — finance: confirm discount math and whether $75k quarter is acceptable for a one-off waiver.
Marissa/Stephanie — legal/ops: do we need a special SLA addendum or can we use the standard uplift addendum with a region pin?

Thanks,
Jasmine

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: INTERNAL: Olive AI uplift ask — SLA + region + cooldown waiver (urgent)

Short answer: yes, we can support 150ms p95 at 4x baseline for a short window if we provision an isolated burst pool and pre-warm KV caches. Caveats:
- We need a pre-warm window of ~6 hours immediately before peak traffic to populate prefix/KV caches.
- For guaranteed latency, we should reserve dedicated nodes rather than relying on shared autoscale to avoid noisy neighbors. Temporary uplift should include an isolated burst pool assignment (adds fixed infra cost).
- If Olive plans to multi-region failover, we need to sync routing; otherwise pin to us-west as requested.

I'll prepare a tech note to include in the addendum that documents the pre-warm requirement and the pool sizing assumptions.

Karthik
Senior Director, Serving Runtime

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Park <sam@olive.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 16:40:18 -0700
Subject: RE: Launch week capacity - confirm uplift addendum and next steps

Hi Sam — thanks for the clarity and patience. Per internal approvals: Finance has approved the $75k quarterly minimum tied to the one-time cooldown waiver; Ops can guarantee a us-west pinned burst pool with the caveat Karthik outlined (6-hour pre-warm).

Attached is a draft addendum (dynamic-burst-term-draft-v1.pdf) that includes:
- 7-day temporal uplift (dates to be filled by Olive) at 1.25x baseline rate
- p95 latency commitment of 150ms for gen requests during uplift window, with exclusion for non-prewarmed traffic and force-majeure events
- One-time cooldown waiver conditioned on $75k minimum spend that quarter
- Region pinning to us-west for the uplift window and the requirement that Olive provide traffic routing cutover instructions 48 hours before start

If Olive signs and returns the addendum, we will schedule the pre-warm runbook and reserve the burst pool. I'll also loop Legal to finalize the SLA language.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

---

Note: Attachments referenced above: 2027-07-29_OliveAI_launch_estimate.xlsx (cost worksheet), dynamic-burst-term-draft-v1.pdf (addendum).
